task: Hypothesis for page-based stories: end some pages on a question or an open 'says...' and answer it after the turn.
recommendation: As writing guidance only, via the generic-hook route (no engine change): adventure and learning, mid-story, never bedtime / last page / episode end, never danger questions. Specific question-answer pairs wait until the corpus supports cross-beat linking.

tests: a page-end question variant is only selectable when the next page's chosen variant answers it

safety.notes: Conditions: within-story only, never on the last page or episode ends; excluded from bedtime mode (or confined to its first half); hook questions not about danger or the unknown; page emotion stays within ceiling 2 and the parent's ContentSafety level.

done_when: The guidance is written into the content line's writing rules; corpus validators still pass.
Works on its own branch or worktree, never on main; nothing is merged without the product owner.
Existing tests stay green and new behaviour has tests.
A Değişiklik günlüğü entry is added (CLAUDE.md).
`ba exchange handoff p_spread_end_hook --status done --note <branch@commit>` is recorded.
